title: Five compliments
description: Give each other five genuine compliments — no repeats, no 'you look nice'.

title: Kitchen slow dance
description: Put on a song you both love and slow dance wherever you are.

title: Hidden love note
description: Hide a handwritten note somewhere your partner will find it later.

title: Phone-free hour
description: Spend one full hour together with both phones in another room.

title: Recreate a photo
description: Find an old photo of the two of you and recreate it as closely as you can.

title: Cook something new
description: Cook a dish neither of you has made before, together.

title: Three thank-yous
description: Tell each other three specific things you're grateful for this week.

title: Childhood story swap
description: Each share a childhood story the other has never heard.

title: Walk with no destination
description: Go for a 20-minute walk with no plan — take turns choosing each turn.

title: Make a playlist
description: Build a 10-song playlist together: five picks each, no vetoes.

title: Draw each other
description: Draw each other's portrait in two minutes. Share on the Canvas.

title: Letter to future us
description: Write a short letter to open on your next anniversary.

title: Ten-minute massage
description: Trade five-minute shoulder massages.

title: Tiny date
description: A ten-minute date: tea, a candle, and one question from a deck.

title: Learn a word
description: Teach each other one word in a language you don't speak.

title: Dream bigger
description: Add three new items to your bucket list together.

title: Memory lane
description: Scroll back through your Memories and pick your favourite from each month.

title: Look up
description: Step outside tonight and find one star or the moon together — even if you're apart.

title: Snack swap
description: Each pick a snack for the other to try.

title: Twenty-second hug
description: Hug for a full twenty seconds. Count out loud if you have to.

title: Candlelit dinner
description: Eat dinner by candlelight, even if it's takeout.

title: Ask me anything
description: Ask each other three questions you've always wondered about.

title: Song dedication
description: Send each other a song that reminds you of them and explain why.

title: Dream trip
description: Plan a dream trip in 15 minutes: destination, three activities, one splurge.

title: Catch the sunrise
description: Wake up early and watch the sunrise together (video call counts).

title: Double kindness
description: Each do one kind thing for a stranger today and tell the other about it.

title: Game night
description: Play any game together — the loser plans the next date.

title: Blind movie pick
description: One picks a movie, the other can't see the title until it starts.

title: Four-line poem
description: Write each other a four-line poem. Rhyming optional, love mandatory.

title: Goal check
description: Share one personal goal and one way the other can help.

title: Photo walk
description: Take five photos each on a walk and send your best as a Daily Snap.

title: Breakfast in bed
description: Surprise the other with breakfast (or a delivered coffee if apart).

title: Voice note
description: Send a 60-second voice note about why you love them.

title: Slow morning
description: First hour of the day together, no screens.

title: Dance party
description: Three songs, full volume, dance like nobody's watching.

title: Favourites quiz
description: Quiz each other on favourites: food, film, colour, song, place.

title: Love map
description: Draw a map of your relationship's key places on the Canvas.

title: Remember when
description: Each describe the moment you knew you liked the other.

title: Living-room picnic
description: Blanket on the floor, snacks, and a deck of questions.

title: Mood board
description: Make a Canvas mood board for your next date.
